description: Performance baselines for CI regression detection. Failing thresholds will cause CI to fail.

calibration.measured: 21 CI runs on ubuntu-latest: 6 on 2026-10-16 (38873548108 to 38902420186) and 15 on 2026-10-19 (39212944344 to 39258982047). ensure_project and file_reservation_paths_conflict: 20 runs of the Benchmark calibration workflow on 2026-10-21 (39612970518)
calibration.rule: Every limit is set from the worst run, in either direction. p95/p99 (fail CI) = 2x the worst run, or 2.5x for benchmarks with 15 or fewer iterations, where p95/p99 is effectively the single slowest iteration. Mean (warns) = 1.5x the worst run. Rounded up to 10 ms. Runner speed varies about 2x between runs. Each dataset is the one its benchmark runs, and the check fails if they differ (#28).
